messages:
Noah R: Hi team  First day notes: I clicked the Okta invite but got 'email already in use'. I have two aliases in Google Workspace (noah.r@redwood.dev and noah.r+contractor@redwood.dev) 1 could that cause it? Also my YubiKey hasn't shipped yet so can't do security key enroll. 1Password shows no access. Who should I ping for a temp access link?

Kai (IT): Welcome Noah! The alias can definitely cause collisions if a prior placeholder account used the plus address. Can you confirm which exact address the invite was sent to? Also can you paste the full Okta error (screenshot helps)?

Noah R: Invite sent to noah.r+contractor@redwood.dev. Error text: "Account creation failed: email already exists (E103)". Screenshot uploaded to the onboarding doc.

Maya - People Ops: Thanks. We normally standardize on the base address (no plus). Will add you to onboarding-temp while IT resolves the collision so you get calendars and docs. Do you need immediate code repo access or just docs/calendar for now?

Noah R: Docs + calendar first. I can wait on code until SSO resolves. Also, can IT flag the pending YubiKey shipment? Tracking says delayed.

Kai (IT): Copy. Ill look up the pre-provisioned placeholder account; often contractors or previous invites made an account with the plus alias. If it's a stale stub we can merge or remove it. Ill open ticket IT-52390 and reissue a temporary magic link (24h) that bypasses the invite flow so you can finish setup without the hardware key.

infra-bot: [automated] Ticket IT-52390 created by Kai (IT)  "Okta alias collision + temp magic link for noah.r+contractor". ETA 3h.

Kai (IT): Ok, I removed the stale stub and reissued a fresh invite to noah.r@redwood.dev (base address). I also generated a one-time magic link and DM'ed it to you (expires in 12h). Please try sign-in in a private window.

Noah R: Tried the magic link in incognito, and the account creation flow completed. I enrolled Okta Verify with SMS as fallback (YubiKey still pending). I can see my Google calendar and onboarding docs via the onboarding-temp group 1 thanks!

Maya - People Ops: Great. I've also escalated the YubiKey shipment to shipping@vendor.com and booked expedited courier. Your 1Password seat was provisioned (internal ticket PL-1012) so expect email invite shortly. Welcome aboard! :tada:

Noah R: Got 1Password invite and set up vault access. All green on my end. Thanks everyone for the fast help.

Kai (IT): Glad it's sorted. If you prefer hardware key only later, ping us and we'll add the YubiKey to your account and remove SMS. Enjoy your first day!
